---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Top 100 Song Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Rank progression over weeks on the chart",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank (Lower is better)"
  )
```
